description:
Chris Smither talks about how he was cast in the short film 'The Singers'
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Singer-songwriter Chris Smither, interviewed here by Radio Heartland's Mike Pengra in August 2024, talks about how he landed a role in the Oscar-winning short film, "The Singers." Directed by Sam Davis, "The Singers" is now available on Netflix.

Chris Smither's most recent album is "All About the Bones."

description:
David Huckfelt shares his rule for learning to play cover songs
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Minneapolis singer-songwriter David Huckfelt’s latest album, “I Was Born, But…” is a collection of 17 cover songs that Huckfelt recorded over two days at Dust & Stone Studios in Tucson, Arizona. In a recent interview with Diane, host of The Local Show, Huckfelt describes how he decides which cover songs to learn. "If a song brought me to tears," Huckfelt explains, "I would learn that song, and I would sing it."

Huckfelt's album, "I Was Born, But..." is available on @dongiovannirecords .

Find more about Huckfelt's album in this feature at thecurrent.org: https://www.thecurrent.org/feature/2026/01/15/david-huckfelt-keeps-the-memories-of-the-past-alive-on-new-covers-album
